meta.title: Pricing | Revora
meta.description: Clear pricing in Algerian dinars (DZD), per user. Start free and pay by CCP, bank transfer or cash.

pricing.title: Simple pricing for the *platform*, in DZD
pricing.body: You pay per user, per month. Start for free and move up a plan as your team grows. Need support? Our services are priced on quote.
pricing.indicative: Indicative prices. Final amounts are confirmed in your quote before you subscribe.
pricing.compareCaption: Comparison table of the Free, Pro and Business plans

payment.title: Payment methods
payment.body: Pay the way you are used to. Exact terms are set out in your quote.

items.title: CCP
items.body: Pay by transfer to your CCP account.

items.title: Bank transfer
items.body: Transfer to the Revora account, with your invoice reference.

items.title: Cash
items.body: Pay in cash, with a receipt.

items.question: Are prices per user?
items.answer: Yes. Prices are in Algerian dinars (DZD), per user, per month or per year.

items.question: Can I start for free?
items.answer: Yes. The Free plan is limited to one user and includes credit sales and contacts.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: By CCP, bank transfer or cash. Terms are set out in your quote.

items.question: Can I change plan later?
items.answer: Yes, you can move to a higher plan as your team grows. Terms are set out when you subscribe.

items.question: Are prices final?
items.answer: No, they are indicative. The final amount is confirmed before you subscribe.

items.question: Can I keep my data on my own servers?
items.answer: Yes, for companies that must keep their data in Algeria. See the On-premise page.

bottomCta.title: A plan to start tomorrow

services.title: Services on quote
services.body: The platform is not always enough on its own. Our team, who worked in marketing, sales and back office, helps you find where growth is lost, then rebuild it.

items.title: Training

items.title: Support

indexMeta.title: Solutions by business | Revora
indexMeta.description: Revora for appliance and furniture shops, car dealers, clinics, training centres and retail shops with a till.

solutions.indexBody: Every business loses growth in a different place. Choose your sector to see how Revora helps, with the platform and our services.
solutions.ctaTitle: Try it with your own customers
solutions.ctaBody: Create your account for free and set up your first payment plan in a few minutes.

electromenager-credit.title: Appliances and credit sales
electromenager-credit.short: Sell on credit without missing a single instalment, and turn customers into regular buyers.
electromenager-credit.problem: Your credit sales are written in notebooks. You don't always know who owes what or who is late, and chasing payments takes your sales team's time.
electromenager-credit.solution: Revora tracks every payment schedule, chases late payments and keeps each contract linked to its customer. Our services audit your credit process and set it up with your team.
electromenager-credit.headline: Sell on credit, *without missing an instalment*.
electromenager-credit.problemLine: Your instalments are written in notebooks.
before: Guarantors and debt notes on paper
after: Numbered contracts linked to each customer

car-dealers.title: Car dealers
car-dealers.short: Follow every prospect, deposit and vehicle in one place.
car-dealers.problem: Each vehicle has its file, its deposits and its prospects. Information is scattered across files, messages and notebooks, and prospects go cold.
car-dealers.solution: A sales pipeline for every prospect, quotes and invoices linked to each sale, and stock tracking. Our services structure the sales process and train your team.
car-dealers.headline: Every vehicle, *its full file*.
car-dealers.problemLine: Contracts, deposits and prospects are scattered.
before: Paper contracts and guarantors to find
Prospects scattered across messages and notebooks
after: A sales pipeline for every prospect

clinics.title: Health: clinics and practices
clinics.short: Patient files, VAT invoicing and instalment payments, in one tool.
clinics.problem: Patients pay in several instalments, services must be invoiced correctly, and records are hard to find when you need them.
clinics.solution: Customer files, clear VAT invoicing, instalment payments with reminders and access from a phone. Our services organise reception and billing.
clinics.headline: Fewer lost files, *more payments on time*.
clinics.problemLine: Split payments and files that are hard to follow.
before: Paper files that are hard to find
after: Reminders and tracking from a phone

training-centers.title: Training centres
training-centers.short: Enrolments, invoices and learner reminders, to fill your sessions.
training-centers.problem: Enrolments arrive through many channels, payments are split and reminders are sent by hand, so enrolments are lost.
training-centers.solution: A pipeline for every prospect, invoices and schedules per learner, and automatic reminders. Our services set up the enrolment path.
training-centers.headline: More enrolments, *fewer manual reminders*.
training-centers.problemLine: Enrolments and payments tracked by hand.

retail-pos.title: Retail and distribution
retail-pos.short: Till, stock and sales connected, so you sell more without stock-outs or errors.
retail-pos.problem: Stock is out of date, the till and invoicing don't talk to each other, and you can't see your margins in real time.
retail-pos.solution: The till is linked to stock and invoicing, dashboards show your sales live, and our services organise your restocking.
retail-pos.headline: Sell without stock-outs, *with reliable stock*.
retail-pos.problemLine: Stock, till and invoices don't talk to each other.
after: Till and invoicing in one place

professional-services.title: Services and contractors
professional-services.short: Quotes, projects and billing of services, with time tracking.
professional-services.problem: Quotes go out late, projects drift and time spent is not billed properly.
professional-services.solution: Quotes and invoices linked to projects, time tracked per task and structured client support. Our services find where your services lose margin.
professional-services.headline: Every service, *billed and tracked*.
after: Quotes and invoices linked to projects

industry.title: Industry and production
industry.short: Stock, purchasing and SCF accounting to track materials and costs.
industry.problem: Raw materials are poorly tracked, supplier orders are placed on instinct and costs are only known at month end.
industry.solution: Multi-warehouse stock, supplier purchase orders and SCF accounting entries. Our services frame your purchasing and production with your team.
industry.headline: Materials and costs, *under control*.
industry.problemLine: Stock and costs are poorly tracked.
before: Costs known only at month end

meta.title: On-premise | Revora
meta.description: Install Revora on your own servers in Algeria, with Docker, backups and installation support.

onPremise.title: Your data *stays in Algeria*
onPremise.body: Some companies must keep their data on Algerian soil. Revora can run on your own servers, with Docker.
onPremise.legal: ⚠ Legal framework (Law 18-07 on personal data protection): to be reviewed by a lawyer before publication.
onPremise.requirementsTitle: What you need to install it
requirements: Docker Engine 24 or later, with the Compose plugin
A server with at least 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM and 40 GB disk
A domain name and an HTTPS reverse proxy (Caddy, nginx or Traefik)

steps.title: Install Docker
steps.body: Prepare the server, open only the HTTPS port and keep the database closed to the Internet.

steps.title: Migrate the database
steps.body: Fill in the environment file, then start the containers. Migrations apply automatically.

steps.title: Turn on backups
steps.body: A compressed database backup is created by script and kept for 14 days.

steps.title: Support
steps.body: Installation help and a support contract are available on request.

backups: A database backup is created by script, compressed and kept for 14 days.
Files (invoices, attachments) are backed up on the same schedule as the database.
Restore runs on an empty database, in a few documented commands.
included: The full application, with all the modules of your plan
Help with the first setup, on request
onPremise.support: Installation help and a support contract are available on request. Terms are set out in your quote.
onPremise.ctaBody: Tell us how many users you are and what data constraints you have. We will get back to you.

guarantees.title: Data on your servers
guarantees.body: Revora runs on your infrastructure, in Algeria. You stay in control of your data.

guarantees.title: Scheduled backups
guarantees.body: Database and files are backed up on the same schedule. Restore steps are documented.

guarantees.title: Controlled updates
guarantees.body: Back up, pull the new version and restart. Migrations already applied are not replayed.

guarantees.title: Full application
guarantees.body: The complete app with the modules of your plan and scheduled tasks.
